jobs.description:
Are you passionate about recruitment but looking for a role that goes beyond talent acquisition alone?

Our client, a renowned international media and marketing group, is looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to play a key role in attracting top talent while contributing to broader People & Culture initiatives.

 

 

This is a unique opportunity to combine strategic recruitment, employer branding, employee experience and HR projects within a dynamic, creative and fast-paced environment.

Your Role as Talent Acquisition Manager 

As Talent Acquisition Manager, you will become a trusted partner to business leaders and a key member of the People team.

Talent Acquisition (70%)

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake meetings to offer management and onboarding.
• Partner closely with hiring managers to define recruitment strategies and hiring needs.
• Develop innovative sourcing approaches to attract top talent across Belgium.
• Deliver an outstanding candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
• Strengthen employer branding initiatives in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
• Monitor recruitment KPIs and continuously improve processes through data and insights.
• Optimise the use of recruitment tools and ATS platforms.
 

People & Culture Projects (30%)

• Contribute to employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
• Support discussions and projects related to compensation & benefits.
• Collaborate on broader HR and organisational development projects.
• Help foster an inclusive, engaging and people-focused company culture.
• Work alongside HR colleagues to continuously improve People practices.

Your Profile as Talent Acquisition manager 

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, either in-house or within a recruitment consultancy.
• Experience recruiting within dynamic, fast-growing, creative, media, marketing or professional services environments is highly valued.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and advise senior leaders.
• Passionate about recruitment while maintaining a broader interest in HR topics.
• Comfortable working with ATS systems; experience with Greenhouse is a plus.
• Structured, proactive and solution-oriented.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

For an international organization within the medical sector based in Ghent, we are looking for an experienced Accountant to support the financial management of the Belgian operations. In this varied role, you will take broad responsibility for a range of financial and accounting processes.

Your responsibilities:

• You will manage the full accounting cycle (A to Z) for the Belgian entity and its related holding structure.
• You will be responsible for both general and analytical accounting, ensuring the accuracy and quality of financial data.
• You will act as the main point of contact for accounting and financial matters within the organization.
• You will handle monthly and annual closings and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
• You will prepare annual accounts and various statutory and tax filings, including VAT, Intrastat and statistical reporting.
• You will monitor outstanding receivables and payables and process payments and payroll-related accounting entries.
• You will work closely with external partners and advisors on tax matters, subsidies and other financial topics.
• You will support the annual audit process and act as a key contact during financial audits.
• You will contribute to budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis, helping to identify and explain deviations from financial targets.
• You will perform balance sheet reconciliations and controls, ensuring that discrepancies are identified and followed up appropriately.
• You will actively contribute to the improvement and optimization of financial processes, systems and procedures, working closely with the corporate finance team.

About you:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.
• You have at least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting.
• You have a strong knowledge of general and analytical accounting.
• Experience in an international or corporate environment is considered an advantage.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• You have strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail.
• You are independent, proactive and solution-oriented, while also being a strong team player.
• You are able to set priorities and maintain a high level of accuracy, even when working under tight deadlines.
• You are IT-minded and comfortable working with ERP systems and Excel.

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

You'll be part of a renewable energy consultancy with global reach, focused on creating sustainable solutions for tomorrow. The culture of the company is more informal but in a professional way, open and supportive, offering you both professional growth and the chance to contribute to meaningful projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain and update internal systems and databases (e.g. project tracking, HR and finance tools)
• Coordinate schedules and resources for internal programmes and training sessions
• Assist with reporting, data checks and preparing presentations for management
• Support HR processes such as onboarding administration and training follow-up
• Handle administrative follow-up for suppliers and internal approvals
• Ensure accurate documentation, filing and archiving (digital and hard copy)
• Take on ad hoc administrative tasks that keep the office and operations running smoothly

• 2+ years of experience in administration, coordination or office support
• Organised, detail-oriented and flexible in handling different priorities
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• A strong communicator in English, Dutch (and French)
• Proactive, service-minded and a natural team player
• Diploma in administration, business or similar is a plus but not required

Are you an experienced Executive Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment? Do you enjoy supporting senior executives, managing complex priorities, and acting as a trusted partner at the highest level of an organisation? Our client, a leading international company undergoing an exciting phase of growth and development, is looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to its C-Level leadership team on a 6-month fixed-term assignment.

This position requires a highly professional, discreet and proactive individual who is comfortable operating in a dynamic environment where priorities can evolve quickly.

Your Responsibilities as Executive Assistant:

As Executive Assistant, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day functioning of the leadership team.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex and constantly evolving calendars.
• Coordinating meetings, board meetings and executive appointments.
• Organising international travel arrangements, including itineraries, accommodation and logistics.
• Preparing presentations, reports and executive documentation.
• Acting as a key liaison between internal and external stakeholders.
• Screening and prioritising communications on behalf of senior management.
• Coordinating confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
• Following up on action points and ensuring timely completion of key deliverables.
• Supporting the organisation of executive events, leadership meetings and strategic initiatives.
• Anticipating needs and proactively identifying solutions to facilitate executive decision-making.

Your Profile as Executive Assistant

• Proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Level executives.
• Strong experience managing complex agendas and international stakeholders.
• Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of professionalism.
• Exceptional attention to detail and strong problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office and digital collaboration tools

• Answer phone calls and emails from customers and partners.

• Collect and verify information.

• Provide technical support and maintain contact with repair workshops.

• Keep customers and all involved parties informed in a timely manner.

Are you an organised, proactive and detail-oriented administrative professional looking to join an international environment?

Our client, a leading European industry association based in Brussels, is looking for an Team Assistant to support several international sector groups. This is a varied position where you will work closely with senior stakeholders and contribute to the smooth running of international committees and projects.

Your responsibilities as Team Assistant

As Administrative Assistant, you will provide day-to-day support to the Sector Group Managers and ensure that all administrative processes run efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex agendas, meetings and appointments.
• Organising onsite, hybrid and virtual meetings, workshops and networking events.
• Preparing agendas, invitations, registration forms and meeting documentation.
• Coordinating travel arrangements across Europe.
• Supporting meetings before, during and after the event, including reporting and follow-up.
• Preparing and sending membership invoices and supporting financial administration.
• Maintaining internal databases and CRM systems (Salesforce).
• Managing document archiving according to internal procedures.
• Updating sector group websites and supporting digital communication activities.
• Acting as a key administrative contact for members and external stakeholders.
• Providing general administrative support to several international sector groups.

Your profile as Team Assistant

• Bachelor's degree in Office Management, Management Assistant or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in an administrative or management assistant role.
• Experience within an international organisation, association or membership-based environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Additional European languages are an advantage.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint).
• Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce) and website management is considered a plus.
• Highly organised, able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and able to work independently.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-focused mindset.
• Curious, eager to learn and always looking for ways to improve processes.
• Able to anticipate needs and take initiative before issues arise.

As a Salesforce Technical Lead Consultant, you lead the technical delivery of Salesforce projects from solution design to implementation. You work closely with consultants and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions.

You combine technical leadership with a hands-on approach. From supporting pre-sales and defining solution architectures to mentoring developers and contributing code yourself, you’re as comfortable presenting ideas in the boardroom as solving technical challenges in the codebase.

Experience with Salesforce architecture, integrations, and DevOps is essential. Professional proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Experience in life sciences, regulatory compliance, and data security is a plus.

For our client in Hoogstraten, we are looking for a Customer Service Representative Travel Europe with immediate permanent employment.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the main point of contact for the customers when it comes to orders, production process follow up, deliveries and introduction of new products. Together with the team of colleagues in the Belgian office and worldwide you ensure the highest level of satisfaction and are able to provide a solution to any problem, either commercial or logistical.

Main Responsibilties: 

 
• End-to-end customer service: from order intake to delivery and aftersales follow-up 
 
• Processing and monitoring sales orders (order entry, production follow-up, delivery tracking) 
 
• Handling complaints and finding solutions in close cooperation with sales 
 
• Daily coordination with internal departments and international stakeholders 
 
• Forecasting, demand management and stock monitoring 
 
• Supporting the sales team with commercial and operational tasks 
 
• Ensuring excellent customer satisfaction at all times

Typical day: 
 
• Morning: order entry and administrative processing 
 
• Afternoon: customer follow-up and complaint handling 

 
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience 
 
• Minimum of 2 years' commercial experience in an international B-to B market environment 
 
• Experience with ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite 
 
• Knowledge of logistics, INCO terms and customs procedures is preferred 
 
• Positive mindset, desire to learn and improve yourself as well as existing processes, attention to detail and problem solving 
 
• Proficient in English and Dutch both oral and written, German or Spanish are an advantage

Are you passionate about supply chain operations and ensuring materials are available when and where they are needed? Do you enjoy working with data, planning processes, and cross-functional stakeholders to keep operations running smoothly? Then this temporary opportunity could be the perfect next step in your career.
 

Your Challenge
 

As a Supply Chain Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting material planning, inventory management, and supply chain continuity. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to ensure the availability of critical materials and contribute to the optimization of supply chain processes.
 

What will you do?
 

 
• Manage material availability and inventory levels to support uninterrupted operations.
 
• Maintain and optimize SAP MRP parameters.
 
• Follow up on material shortages, replenishment activities, and planning actions.
 
• Collaborate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues.
 
• Monitor and analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to material planning and supply chain workflows.
 
• Contribute to process optimization projects aimed at increasing efficiency and reliability across the supply chain. 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
 
• Experience with SAP, MRP planning, and inventory management processes.
 
• Strong analytical skills and advanced knowledge of Excel.
 
• Fluent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
 
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
 
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
 
• Strong attention to detail with a results-driven mindset.
 
• Previous experience within the semiconductor industry is considered a strong asset.

CLdN is an international logistics player with a strong European network and a clear focus on efficient and sustainable maritime connections. For CLdN RoRo Agencies NV in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a motivated Customs & Border Compliance Officer for the logistics department.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 

As a Customs & Border Compliance Officer, you will follow up on all customs and compliance activities within Shipping, Port and Door-to-Door processes. You act as the link between internal teams, customers and authorities, ensuring a smooth and compliant flow of goods.
 
 

• Manage customs formalities and ensure compliance with applicable legislation. 

• Apply for and follow up on permits (AEO, bonded warehouse, temporary storage, …) and liaise with 

customs and port authorities. 

• Act as the point of contact for customs-related matters and support internal and external stakeholders. 

• Prepare and improve procedures, KPIs and reporting. 

• Optimize processes and resolve operational issues. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a very good command of Dutch and English; additional languages are a plus. 

• You preferably have a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field, with some exposure to customs, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You preferably have experience or knowledge in customs, shipping or port operations, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You are eager to learn and able to quickly process and master a large amount of complex information and legislation. 

• You have a hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving skills. 

• You possess excellent communication skills and easily build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

• You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every 12 weeks, including weekends/evenings).

• You check and handle glass bottles at the end of the production line

• You cool and pack finished products according to guidlines

• You work with automated inspection systems to detect defects

• You also carry out manual quality checks when needed

• You identify errors and adjust the process to improve quality and efficiency

• You help keep the production safe and running smoothly

• Experience in production or strong interest in production work

• You work accurately and follow quality standards

• Technical insight to understand machines and processes

• You can work with computer systems

• You are not color blind (quality control requirement)

• You speak and understand English well

Are you an experienced HR professional looking for a role where you can combine hands-on HR management with strategic organisational development?

Our client is a growing international organisation based in Brussels, with teams across several European countries. As the organisation continues to expand, they are looking for an HR Manager to build and structure their HR function and support their international growth.

This is a broad role with significant autonomy, working closely with leadership and managers across multiple countries.

Your responsibilities as HR Manager

As HR Manager, you will be responsible for developing a lean, scalable and effective HR framework while ensuring excellent day-to-day HR support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing and structuring recruitment processes in line with the organisation's growth plans.
• Overseeing onboarding, offboarding and employee lifecycle processes.
• Ensuring HR policies and practices are compliant across different European jurisdictions.
• Working with external payroll providers and HR partners.
• Developing and implementing HR policies and processes.
• Supporting managers with performance management, employee development and coaching.
• Developing training and learning initiatives.
• Contributing to workforce planning and organisational development.
• Providing HR insights and data to support strategic decision-making.
• Supporting leadership on employee engagement, wellbeing and company culture.
• Advising managers on HR-related matters and contributing to the development of a strong performance culture.

Your profile as HR Manager

• You have several years of experience in a broad HR management role, ideally within an international environment.
• You have strong experience in recruitment, ideally across different countries.
• You possess a solid understanding of Belgian employment law and HR compliance, particularly in an international context.
• You have experience with performance management, coaching and employee development.
• You are comfortable building and structuring HR processes in a growing organisation.
• You are both strategic and hands-on, happy to move between long-term projects and operational HR matters.
• You are an excellent communicator and confident stakeholder manager.
• You are fluent in English and French ; additional European languages are an asset.
• You are comfortable working in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and where you can genuinely shape the HR function.

Are you an experienced Executive Assistant looking for a challenging role within a prestigious international environment? Do you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced setting where autonomy, proactivity and attention to detail are essential?

For one of our clients, a leading international law firm in Brussels, we are looking for a Senior Executive Assistant to support Partners and Associates within a high-performing team.

Your responsibilities as Executive Assistant

As an Executive Assistant, you will be responsible for:

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings.
• Organising international travel and handling travel arrangements.
• Preparing meetings and taking minutes when required.
• Providing high-level administrative support to Partners and Associates.
• Managing billing and invoicing, which represents a significant part of the role.
• Reviewing billing narratives and coordinating with Associates to ensure they meet client requirements.
• Handling credit notes, write-offs and other billing-related matters.
• Anticipating the needs of the Partners and proactively supporting them in their daily activities.
• Collaborating closely with the wider Assistant team and providing back-up when needed.

Your profile as Executive Assistant

We are looking for a senior, autonomous and proactive Executive Assistant who enjoys taking ownership and working in a demanding environment.

You ideally have:

• Several years of experience as an Executive Assistant, preferably within a law firm, consultancy or similarly demanding environment.
• Strong experience with billing/invoicing and excellent attention to detail.
• Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
• A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented mindset.
• The confidence to work with senior stakeholders and demanding personalities.
• A stable career history and a mature professional attitude.
• Excellent English skills with French and/or Dutch.
Above all, you are someone who anticipates, takes initiative and does not need to be micromanaged. You are confident, discreet and comfortable working with demanding personalities. Your personality and ability to build trust with the Partners will be just as important as your experience.

Service Technician 
 

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical problems and helping customers? Do you like working independently while also contributing ideas for improvements and new technical projects? Then this opportunity could be the right fit for you.
 

For a company based in the 
Roeselare region, we are looking for a Service Technician who enjoys a varied role. You will work in a technical environment where maintenance, installations, troubleshooting, and project work go hand in hand.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical failures at customer sites. 

• Perform preventive maintenance on a variety of technical installations. 

• Assist with the installation and commissioning of new systems. 

• Contribute to technical improvements and new projects. 

• Act as a point of contact for customers and provide technical advice when needed. 

• Ensure proper follow-up and after-sales support following completed work.  

You will work on a range of systems, including:
 
 

• Water treatment and irrigation installations such as pumps, valves, and PVC piping systems. 

• Mechanical and hydraulic installations. 

• Climate control and irrigation management systems. 

• Electrical installations, switchboards, cabling, and LED lighting systems.  

If you have an interest in design and engineering, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and optimization of electrical control panels.

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a degree in Electricity, Electromechanics, or a similar technical field. 

• You enjoy combining hands-on technical work with problem-solving and analytical thinking. 

• You are flexible and enjoy a diverse range of tasks. 

• You work accurately and take ownership of your responsibilities. 

• Experience as a service technician or in technical project work is an asset. 

• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 

• You possess a valid cat B driving license.

Our client, a well-established company based in Brussels, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Payroll Officer to join their HR team. As part of a small but dynamic structure, you will play a key role in the day-to-day payroll and HR administration. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a multicultural environment and enjoys working with accuracy and autonomy.

Responsibilities as a Payroll Officer:

- Ensure the accurate and timely processing of payroll for employees in Belgium
 - Be the point of contact for payroll-related questions from employees
 - Liaise with the external payroll provider (e.g. Partena) to ensure data integrity
 - Maintain employee records and ensure compliance with local social legislation
 - Assist with HR administrative tasks such as contracts, insurance, and benefits
 - Support the HR team with onboarding and general employee queries

Profile for a Payroll Officer:

- You have proven experience in payroll processing, ideally in Belgium
 - You are fluent in German with a good command of French, English and/or Dutch
 - You are detail-oriented, discreet, and able to handle confidential information
 - You are proactive, organized, and capable of managing priorities independently
 - Familiarity with Partena or a similar payroll provider is a strong asset
 - Good knowledge of Excel and HR tools is expected

Responsibilities

• Review incoming business and user requirements to ensure completeness, consistency, and technical feasibility.
• Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and system behavior.
• Specify system-to-system integrations, including interface payloads, error handling, and non-functional performance constraints.
• Collaborate with architects, developers, and testers to maintain clarity and resolve implementation questions.
• Maintain project documentation and support defect review and User Acceptance Testing campaigns.
• Perform data investigations and validate business rules by directly querying systems.

Requirements

• 3+ years of professional experience in functional analysis, including the production of user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
• You possess professional experience specifying system-to-system integrations using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML.
• You bring a proven ability to write SQL queries independently for data investigation and defect qualification.
• You have experience using Atlassian JIRA and Confluence to author and maintain technical specifications.
• You possess knowledge of non-functional constraints such as latency, throughput, and system availability.
• You're experienced in working within a delivery model where functional analysis is distinct from business analysis.
• You are fluent in English at a C1 level with at least B2 level proficiency in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of modeling notations such as BPMN or UML.
• Experience with API contract design using OpenAPI or Swagger.
• Familiarity with conceptual and logical data modelling and entity-relationship analysis.
• Participation in defect triage and test preparation within complex environments.
